title: 用开源环境 RL 后训练的 Qwen3.8-27B：AA-Omniscience
html:
用开源环境 RL 后训练的 Qwen3.8-27B：AA-Omniscience

Some of the most interesting agent results this year are coming out of post-trains of small open models.

A new RL post-train Qwen3.8-27B model trained with an open-source environments cuts the hallucination rate on AA-Omniscience from 30.4% to 15.1%.

the compressed copy of the mla version fits on my single 24 GB RTX 4090 and holds about 3.5x more context than base Qwen.

It beats GPT 6 Luna-medium on DeepSWE, placing in between Luna 6 medium and high.

scores higher on Terminal-Bench 2.1 while writing a median 23.8K output tokens per solved task, where base Qwen writes 54.9K.

Tried an unreleased version of this model, and really felt the comparative intelligent density, that it writes a lot less.

tops Muse Glimmer 30B and OpenAI’s GPT-6 Luna (high) on Terminal-Bench, τ³-bench, ClawEval and BFCL v4 (Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard), though Luna still wins DeepSWE at 53.1%.

They also released an MLA version, which is the same model with its 16 full-attention layers converted to multi-head latent attention, which shrinks the memory each token takes from 64 KiB to 18 KiB so far more or longer sessions fit on one GPU.

the compressed copy of the mla version fits on my single 24 GB RTX 4090 and holds about 3.5x more context than base Qwen.

scores higher on Terminal-Bench 2.1 while writing a median 23.8K output tokens per solved task, where base Qwen writes 54.9K.

tops Muse Glimmer 30B and OpenAI’s GPT-6 Luna (high) on Terminal-Bench, τ³-bench, ClawEval and BFCL v4 (Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard), though Luna still wins DeepSWE at 53.1%.

html_zh:
用开源环境 RL 后训练的 Qwen3.8-27B：AA-Omniscience

今年一些最有趣的代理结果来自小型开放模型的后期训练。

在开源环境中训练的新 RL 训练后 Qwen3.8-27B 模型将 AA-Omniscience 上的幻觉率从 30.4% 降低到 15.1%。

MLA 版本的压缩副本适合我的单个 24 GB RTX 4090，并且比基础 Qwen 容纳的上下文多大约 3.5 倍。

它在 DeepSWE 上击败了 GPT 6 Luna-medium，介于 Luna 6 中和高之间。

在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上得分更高，同时每个已解决任务写入中位数 23.8K 输出标记，其中基础 Qwen 写入 54.9K。

尝试了这个模型的未发布版本，确实感受到了相对智能密度，它写的少了很多。

在 Terminal-Bench、τ³-bench、ClawEval 和 BFCL v4（伯克利函数调用排行榜）上，Luna 领先于 Muse Glimmer 30B 和 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Luna（高），但 Luna 仍以 53.1% 的胜率赢得 DeepSWE。

他们还发布了 MLA 版本，该模型与模型相同，其 16 个全注意力层转换为多头潜在注意力，这将每个令牌占用的内存从 64 KiB 缩小到 18 KiB，到目前为止，一个 GPU 上可以容纳更多或更长的会话。
